name: Sense CMS TikTok Publisher
author: QUANT Software House Limited
description: Publishes reviewed Sense CMS image posts to connected TikTok accounts with explicit creator controls and consent.

changelog.summary: Reuse recently verified creator choices to prevent transient TikTok API rejection from disabling the editor.
Retry one transient creator-information rejection before disabling publishing choices.
Align account cards, connection metadata, empty state and publishing workflow with the shared Social Publishing interface.
Connect multiple TikTok accounts and publish reviewed image posts with live privacy, interaction, disclosure and consent controls.
